people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses alone shall come near to Yahweh, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”
translations.bsb: Moses alone shall approach the LORD, but the others must not come near. And the people may not go up with him.”
translations.kjv: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up
translations.asv: and Moses alone shall come near unto Jehovah; but they shall not come near; neither shall the people go up with him.
